title: An Introduction to Measure Theory
institution: American Mathematical Society, Graduate Studies in Mathematics 126 (author-hosted online draft)
description: Graduate textbook (2011, 206 pages) derived from the author's blog: Lebesgue measure and integral, abstract measure spaces, modes of convergence, differentiation theorems, outer measures and the Carathéodory extension, product measures. The author's page links an online draft PDF for reading and keeps an errata list keyed to the printed book's page numbers.
rightsNotes: The author's pages link an online draft PDF ('An online version of the text can be found here') but state no licence; the printed book is published by the AMS. Treated as reference-only: readable online by the learner, never imported, never processed by external models.
The author's page states 'There is no solution guide for this text.'
